verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal is an in-person payments platform (SDKs, readers, POS integrations), not an AI agent or assistant that acts as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools is therefore a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only that Stripe publishes its own MCP server, which is the server role and does not make this client-side axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
